profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a Miami, Florida based public company, traded under the ticker HUT, that describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses which acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. According to its own site, the company provides direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

The site states that Hut 8 has fully commercialized its 1 GW Beacon Point AI data center campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, bringing campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion. No specific AI products are listed among the company's tracked offerings.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001964789. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it.
